episode_title: Trump Bans Media from White House, Europe on High Alert, College Sports Bill
script_en: Trump Bans Media from White House, Europe on High Alert, College Sports Bill.
President Trump says he’s banning three news organizations – CNN, MS NOW and Politico – from the White House.
Leaders in France, Poland and across the continent have warned that Russia may about to broaden its war in Europe.
The warning comes after what they say is a spate of brazen Russian attacks.
The Protect College Sports Act — a bill that promises to bring stability to college sports — is racing to clear some of its final hurdles.
